definitions.gloss: to rust; to become rusty; to corrode
definitions.explanation: For metal to develop rust through oxidation. Also used figuratively for skills or abilities that have deteriorated from lack of use.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}のチェーンが{錆|さ}びてしまった。
{雨|あめ}ざらしにすると{鉄|てつ}は{錆|さ}びる。
examples.english: Iron will rust if left out in the rain.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}を{使|つか}わないと{腕|うで}が{錆|さ}びる。
examples.english: If you don't use English, your skills will get rusty.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). No transitive pair exists.

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb
・{錆|さ}びない (negative)
・{錆|さ}びます (polite)
・{錆|さ}びて (te-form)
・{錆|さ}びた (past)

FIGURATIVE USE:
{腕|うで}が{錆|さ}びる (skills become rusty) - Used for abilities that have deteriorated from lack of practice.

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{錆|さび} - rust (noun)
・{錆|さ}びつく - to rust solid, to seize up with rust

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {錆|さび} is specific to rust. It may also be written in hiragana as さびる.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
